fact_checks.quote: A firm, dry surface is best for harvest traffic and field-drying of hay.
fact_checks.scope: Kansas State University Extension alfalfa irrigation management guide; pre-harvest surface condition assessment for equipment traffic and hay drying; deep-rooted perennial alfalfa in managed-field conditions in Kansas
fact_checks.local_evidence_gap: No Iranian provincial or cultivar-specific source consulted; the claim is a bounded observation about a US extension guideline, not a prescription for Iran

fact_checks.quote: Alfalfa is sensitive to water stress at the time of harvest, and rapid re-growth depends on adequate soil water. Watering prior to harvest or immediately after is the best time to promote rapid growth.
fact_checks.scope: Kansas State University Extension; alfalfa post-harvest regrowth dependent on soil-water availability; timing guidance relative to harvest cycle in Kansas production conditions
fact_checks.local_evidence_gap: No Iranian alfalfa post-harvest irrigation study cited; claim is reported as a US extension finding without relabeling it as an Iranian recommendation

fact_checks.quote: An initial estimate or measurement of root-zone soil water is needed, which usually requires the installation of soil-water measuring equipment or soil probing.
fact_checks.scope: Kansas State University Extension; irrigation-scheduling methodology for alfalfa; soil-water measurement approaches including sensors and probing in Kansas management conditions
fact_checks.local_evidence_gap: No Iranian soil-water measurement protocol referenced; claim describes a general-method principle from a US guideline without asserting Iranian operational details

fact_checks.quote: Measurement accuracy depends on the frequency, number, and location of measurements, though.
fact_checks.scope: Kansas State University Extension; alfalfa irrigation scheduling methodology; accuracy of soil-water measurement tied to monitoring design parameters
fact_checks.local_evidence_gap: No Iranian monitoring-design standard cited; the claim reports a methodological principle from a US guide without specifying Iranian sampling frequency or count
